title: EDM foundations: sidechain, pumps, risers, impacts, builds and drops
doc: Shared EDM foundations for every EDM / dubstep / DnB / electro family (docs/EDM_REFERENCES.md): kick, sub, clap, hats, crash; risers, white-noise builds, pitch risers, impacts, sub drops, reverse swells, downlifters; supersaw, pluck, pad; moves for sidechain (duckorbit), trigger-free pump, OTT-style squash, drive, synced wobble, filter and high-pass builds; snare-roll, filter and gap atoms, riser grammars (4 / 8 / 16 bars ending on a point) and the 104-bar song-form gates.
racksDoc: EDM foundation racks (band-scoped, docs/RACK_STANDARD.md): edmKick, subSine, edmClap, snareTight, hats, crash, risers (noiseRiser, hpBuild, pitchRiser), downSweep, reverseSwell, impactBoom, subDrop, superChord, edmPluck, edmPad; moves sidechain(orbit, depth, release), ducked(orbit), lfoPump(depth), ott(gain), drive(amt), wobble(sync, depth), filterBuild, thinBuild. Use: .hook("edmKick | sidechain(2)").

atomsIngredient.title: EDM foundation atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/edm foundation atoms (ec.): four-on-the-floor and off-beat patterns, snare rolls (roll4, roll8 + velocity ramps), filter builds (open8, thin8), gap masks, riser gates (rise4, rise8, rise16, hit), the 104-bar form as gates (intro .. outro, drops, notDrops, gap, fillBars) and as masks (mIntro .. mOutro). Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-edm-core").

section.title: EDM foundations: sidechain, pumps, builds, drops, buses
section.explain: Shared EDM foundations (pack glyphcore/edm, docs/EDM_REFERENCES.md). Sidechain is Strudel's duckorbit: the move sidechain(orbit, depth, release) goes on the kick, ducked(orbit) on what it ducks. lfoPump(depth) is a beat-synced ramp tremolo for a pump without a trigger. Builds are data: ec.roll8 / ec.rollVel8 (snare roll), ec.open8 / ec.thin8 (filter automation), ec.gapMask (the silent beat before the drop), gates ec.rise4 / rise8 / rise16 / hit that end or start on a point, and the 104-bar map ec.intro, build, dropA, breakdown, build2, dropB, switchUp, outro (with drops, notDrops, gap, fillBars). Bus processing (band-split drive, 3-band OTT) is a .split on superdough buses.

edmKick.doc: EDM kick: sine body near 52 Hz, a 3-octave pitch drop in 50 ms for the click, short decay, light shape for weight; high-pass 38 Hz because four kicks a bar put pitch-envelope sidebands under 20 Hz

subSine.doc: clean sub: sine, 5 ms attack (no click), a little shape for harmonics small speakers can play, low-pass 220 Hz; mono by construction

edmClap.doc: clap: band-passed white noise at 1.5 kHz, fast decay

snareTight.doc: tight snare for rolls: triangle body (E3) stacked with white noise, high-passed at 170 Hz, 120 ms

hatClosed.doc: closed hat: white noise over 8 kHz, 35 ms

hatOpen.doc: open hat: white noise over 7 kHz, 200 ms

shaker.doc: shaker: soft 12 ms attack, 60 ms, noise over 5.5 kHz

crash.doc: crash: noise over 5 kHz with a 1.6 s decay, the downbeat marker of a drop

noiseRiser.doc: noise riser: white noise fades in over len seconds while its low-pass opens 4 octaves (700 Hz -> 11 kHz); len = bars x 240 / bpm (4 bars at 140 = 6.86 s)

hpBuild.doc: white-noise build: noise (1 s fade-in) whose high-pass climbs 4 octaves (200 Hz -> 3.2 kHz) over len seconds, so it thins and rises at once

pitchRiser.doc: pitch riser: a saw on C4 that glides up two octaves over len seconds (pitch envelope, anchor at the start), 2 s fade-in, low-passed at 4 kHz

downSweep.doc: downlifter: noise whose low-pass falls 3.5 octaves (11 kHz -> 1 kHz) over 1.8 s after a drop or into a breakdown

reverseSwell.doc: reverse swell: noise that fades in over len seconds and stops dead (20 ms release), so it peaks exactly where its event ends; place it to end on the downbeat

impactBoom.doc: impact: sine on C1 dropping two octaves in 250 ms, 2.2 s tail, light shape; the downbeat of a drop

subDrop.doc: sub drop: a sine that falls from about 130 Hz to C1 over a second (pitch envelope down), clean

superChord.doc: supersaw chords: 7 voices, 0.3 semitone total detune, 0.6 stereo spread; high-pass 180 Hz so the spread never reaches the mono low end

edmPluck.doc: pluck: saw, 200 ms decay, low-pass 1.5 kHz with a 2-octave envelope that closes with the note

edmPad.doc: pad: 4-voice supersaw, 1 s attack, 2.5 s release, filter opens one octave over 2 s

sidechain.doc: sidechain trigger (Strudel duckorbit): put on the kick; every kick ducks the voices on orbit `orbit` to a gain of 1 - sqrt(depth) (superdough: 0.25 = -6 dB, 0.36 = -8 dB, 0.5 = -10.7 dB, 0.8 = -19.5 dB) and they come back over `release` seconds (superdough duckattack)

ducked.doc: sidechain target: send this voice to orbit `orbit`, the one the kick's sidechain move ducks (an orbit has one delay and one reverb)

lfoPump.doc: pump without a trigger (volume shaper, LFOTool-style): a ramp tremolo synced to the beat (4 per bar) dips each beat by `depth` and swells back; works on held chords

ott.doc: OTT-style squash on one band: fast, deep downward compression (-30 dB threshold, 6:1, 3 ms / 80 ms) then `gain` trims after the Web Audio compressor's own makeup gain (measured on the rack audit chord: +11 dB before the trim, +5 dB net at the default 0.5); quiet detail comes up relative to the peaks; a 3-band version is a .split on buses (Syntax: EDM foundations)

drive.doc: drive: superdough distortion (scurve, amount `amt`, output 0.6); after the filters, so it sees band-limited input. DC grows with the amount (measured on the audit chord: -48.8 dBFS at 1, -33.2 at 2): above 1 put a high-pass on the bus or master (engine/master: 25 Hz)

wobble.doc: wobble: the low-pass LFO synced to the bar (`sync` periods per bar: 2 = half notes, 4 = quarters, 8 = eighths, 6 / 12 = triplets) at `depth` x the cutoff; needs an lpf in the rack

filterBuild.doc: 8-bar filter build: the low-pass steps open bar by bar (ec.open8: 300 Hz -> 6 kHz), the automation of a build written as data

thinBuild.doc: 8-bar thinning: the high-pass climbs bar by bar (ec.thin8: 30 -> 800 Hz), so the low end empties before the drop

fourFloor.doc: four on the floor: a kick on every beat

offHats.doc: off-beat hats: the and of every beat

roll8.doc: 8-bar snare roll: quarters, eighths, sixteenths, then 32nds in the last bar

pump16.doc: velocity pump on 16ths (for 16th-segmented parts): dips on each beat

gapMask.doc: 8-bar build mask: the last beat is silent (the breath before the drop)

dropMask.doc: 4-bar loop with a silent last beat

intro.doc: bars 1-16 of the 104-bar map: intro (kick and atmosphere, no bass)

build.doc: bars 17-24: first build (roll, riser, filter opens)

breakdown.doc: bars 41-56: breakdown (no kick, no bass; chords and lead)

switchUp.doc: bars 77-88: switch-up inside drop B (new bass pattern or timbre, same kit)

outro.doc: bars 89-104: outro (DJ-friendly: drums and atmosphere, bass out)

notDrops.doc: everything except the drops (mute a drop-only lane with it)

gap.doc: the last beat before each drop: the breath

fillBars.doc: the bar before each section change: fills

mIntro.doc: mask form of ec.intro for plain Strudel (.mask): 1 in bars 1-16 of the 104-bar map

rise4.doc: 4 bars that end exactly on a point: short riser

rise8.doc: 8 bars that end on a point: the standard build

rise16.doc: 16 bars that end on a point: long build (trance, progressive)

hit.doc: the bar that starts on a point: impact, crash, downlifter

recipes.title: EDM kick, four on the floor
recipes.intent: Sine kick with a fast pitch drop on every beat.

recipes.title: Clean sub (sine)
recipes.intent: A mono sine sub under C minor roots, 5 ms attack, held to the next note.

recipes.title: EDM clap
recipes.intent: Band-passed noise clap on 2 and 4.

recipes.title: Off-beat hats and shaker
recipes.intent: Open hats on the and of every beat, 16th shaker under them.

recipes.title: Crash on the downbeat
recipes.intent: A long noise crash that marks the first beat of a drop.

recipes.title: Sidechain ducking (kick ducks the chords)
recipes.intent: Every kick ducks the supersaw chords on orbit 2 by depth 0.5 (-10.7 dB); they swell back over 200 ms: the pump.
recipes.notes: duckorbit on the kick (the trigger) and orbit on the chords (the target): Strudel's sidechain. One orbit = one delay and one reverb, so keep ducked parts that need different sends on separate orbits.

recipes.title: Pump without a trigger (volume shaper)
recipes.intent: A beat-synced ramp tremolo dips the held chords on every beat and swells back, with no kick needed.

recipes.title: 8-bar snare roll
recipes.intent: Quarters, eighths, sixteenths, then 32nds in the last bar, velocity rising from 0.35 to 1.

recipes.title: Noise riser (4 bars)
recipes.intent: White noise fades in over 4 bars at 140 bpm while its low-pass opens four octaves.

recipes.title: White-noise build (high-pass climb)
recipes.intent: Noise at full level whose high-pass climbs four octaves over 4 bars: it thins and rises.

recipes.title: Pitch riser
recipes.intent: A saw that glides up two octaves over 4 bars.

recipes.title: Impact boom
recipes.intent: Sine boom on C1 with a two-octave pitch drop and a 2 s tail.

recipes.title: Sub drop
recipes.intent: A clean sine falling from about 130 Hz to C1 over a second.

recipes.title: Reverse swell into the downbeat
recipes.intent: Noise fades in over a bar and stops dead on the next downbeat.

recipes.title: Downlifter
recipes.intent: Noise whose low-pass falls from 11 kHz to 1 kHz after the downbeat.

recipes.title: Supersaw chords
recipes.intent: 7-voice supersaw, wide above 180 Hz, C minor to A-flat major.

recipes.title: EDM pluck
recipes.intent: Saw pluck whose filter closes with each note.

voices.pat: c4 eb4 g4 bb4 c5 bb4 g4 eb4

recipes.title: EDM pad
recipes.intent: Slow supersaw pad whose filter opens over two seconds.

recipes.title: OTT-style squash on a pluck
recipes.intent: The pluck through deep fast compression with makeup gain: tails and detail come up against the attack.

voices.pat: c4 eb4 g4 bb4 c5 bb4 g4 eb4

recipes.title: 8-bar filter build
recipes.intent: Chords whose low-pass opens bar by bar from 300 Hz to 6 kHz while the high-pass empties the low end.

recipes.title: Build grammar: roll, riser, filter, gap, drop
recipes.intent: 8 bars of build (snare roll, noise riser, filter opening, a silent last beat), then the drop lands with kick, sub and an impact.
recipes.notes: With hooks the same build is gates: ec.build, ec.gap, ec.rise8({ at: "25b" }), ec.hit({ at: "25b" }) (Syntax: EDM foundations).

syntax.title: Sidechain: the kick ducks a bus (duckorbit)
syntax.code:
setcpm(128/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-edm-core")
kick: s(atoms.ec.fourFloor).hook("edmKick | sidechain(2, 0.5, 0.2)")   // trigger: ducks orbit 2
chords: note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").hook("superChord | ducked(2)")   // target: lives on orbit 2

syntax.title: Pump without a trigger (beat-synced ramp tremolo)
syntax.code:
setcpm(128/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-edm-core")
chords: note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").hook("superChord | lfoPump(0.7)")
kick: s(atoms.ec.fourFloor).hook("edmKick")

syntax.title: 8-bar build grammar as gates (roll, riser, filter, breath, impact)
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-edm-core")
hooks.bind("roll", "snareTight", atoms.ec.rise8({ at: "9b" }))
hooks.bind("rise", "noiseRiser(13.3)", atoms.ec.rise8({ at: "9b" }))
hooks.bind("hit", "impactBoom", atoms.ec.hit({ at: "9b" }))
roll: s(atoms.ec.roll8).velocity(atoms.ec.rollVel8).use("roll", { else: "silence" }).mask(atoms.ec.gapMask)
rise: s("<x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~>").use("rise", { else: "silence" })
hit: s("x").use("hit", { else: "silence" })
chords: note("[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]*4").hook("superChord").lpf("<300 450 700 1000 1500 2300 3600 6000 6000 6000>").mask(atoms.ec.gapMask).tags("music")
kick: s(atoms.ec.fourFloor).hook("edmKick").tags("drop")
sub: note("c1").slow(2).hook("subSine").tags("drop")
tagged("drop").mute("<9b")

syntax.title: Band-split drive and 3-band OTT on buses (.split)
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
bass: note("c2*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(1400).attack(0.01).decay(0.18).sustain(0.4).gain(0.25)
  .split(lo => lo.lpf(120).hpf(30),                           // the sub band stays clean and mono
         mid => mid.hpf(120).lpf(2500).distort(1).postgain(0.5), // drive only above 120 Hz
         hi => hi.hpf(2500).compressor(-30).compressorRatio(6).postgain(0.8))
  .merge(m => m.compressor(-18).compressorRatio(3))

syntax.title: Song form as gates (intro, build, drop A, breakdown, build 2, drop B, switch-up, outro)
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-edm-core")
kick: s(atoms.ec.fourFloor).hook("edmKick").tags("drums")
sub: note("c1").hook("subSine").tags("bass")
chords: note("[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]*2").hook("superChord").tags("music")
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.ec.breakdown)
tagged("bass").mute(atoms.ec.notDrops)
tagged("music").mute(atoms.ec.gap)
